name: Lightning Stance
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Lightning Stance (Combat)
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 130
The speed at which you move makes it nearly impossible for opponents to strike you.

Prerequisites: Dex 17, Dodge, Wind Stance, base attack bonus +11.

Benefit: If you take two actions to move or a withdraw action in a turn, you gain 50% concealment for 1 round.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 125
When you take a single move action and move no less than your speed, you can spend 5 stamina points to benefit from a 50% miss chance until the start of your next turn.
